# GitHub Copilot - this repo

Follow **[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)** in the project root first. Then read `wiki/index.md` and `wiki/log.md` before making any changes.

The wiki is durable memory across tools (opencode, Gemini CLI, Copilot, or any other agent TUI) - don't assume the same chat/tool will resume. Follow the `raw/` -> `wiki/` workflow (capture, ingest, link, review, query, lint, discover) described in `AGENTS.md`. Don't invent a parallel structure, and don't overwrite `AGENTS.md`.
